observations.why: Speaker sets a recurring cadence as a directive — enacting authority over the team's operational schedule.
The aphoristic 'we' fuses speaker and audience into a single body that collectively owns or lacks the rollback — communal-sharing enacted through undifferentiated collective possession.
A labeled directive field assigning a recurring cadence — authority-ranking enacted through structured command formatting.
A labeled field assigning ownership to a named individual — authority-ranking enacted through rank-based allocation of responsibility.
